summary: cto checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Handoff: continue only existing reconciliation, failed-run containment, measurement, and bounded security evidence work. No new queue expansion or requeue is justified until deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, and rollback evidence are documented.

CTO review: approve containment-only updates to existing execution reconciliation, failed-run containment, measurement, security evidence, and private-launch work. Create no new proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry requests, dependencies, spend, permissions, deployments, or requeues this cycle. Existing work is technically feasible, isolated, reversible, and measurable with available telemetry. Preserve unknown revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, causal lift, and operational health. Requeue only after documented deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and queue eligibility.

Handoff: update only the existing execution-reconciliation, failed-run containment, measurement, and bounded security-evidence workstreams. Keep private launch gates unchanged. Do not treat unavailable operational or security evidence as passed, and do not create duplicate work.

Continue existing measurement using available impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and already-available AI cost. Preserve unavailable revenue, cost, ROI, margin, incrementality, causal lift, and operational-health fields as unknown.

Continue failed-run containment and repair-or-close review. No requeue is approved until root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused validation, rollback, ownership, and deduplication are documented.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Missing access, secrets, isolation, release, monitoring, incident, and disclosure evidence remains unknown. No credentials, permissions, configuration, deployment, external outreach, or spending changes are authorized.

Keep the private launch gate unchanged. Internal evidence and unsent permission-request preparation may continue, but no external outreach, public exposure, alert expansion, configuration change, deployment, or monetization change is approved without owner and required specialist authorization.
